title: Phyllo
desc: Social graphics for API milestones, creator discovery and brand safety.
lead: I designed Phyllo Wrapped 2024, creator-search promotions and brand-safety graphics for Phyllo and insightIQ.
body: At Phyllo, I turned product messages into social graphics for Phyllo and insightIQ. The work included a Wrapped 2024 recap, API milestones, LinkedIn creator-search promotion and brand-safety communication.
detail: I used illustrated scenes, feature callouts and prominent numbers to explain what the products did. Phyllo’s dark blue and insightIQ’s lime-and-purple treatments gave each set of posts a distinct identity.
contribution: Designed the Wrapped recap, product-feature posts and creator-marketing graphics.
Used illustration, feature callouts and distinct colour treatments for Phyllo and insightIQ.
